title: Maqam Sahib al Zamaan (a)
introduction:
MAQAM SAHIB AL ZAMAAN (A)

The shrine is located in the center of the city of Hilla Asiyfiyah in an area called the (Sunni) and in the market Saffarin to the right of the inside of this market, and the market is located to the left of the inside of the large market, and exactly behind the Great Mosque of Hilla, it is famous for the people of Hilla, (the shrine of disappearance) is derived from the absentee which is one of the names of peace be upon him them.
